items: The laboratory ordered new safety ____ for employees handling chemicals.
'Equipment' means the tools or machinery needed for a particular activity.
The sales team prepared a detailed product ____ for the trade show.
A product 'demonstration' shows how a product works.
The contract includes a two-year ____ covering manufacturing defects.
A 'warranty' is a formal promise to repair or replace a defective product.
The consultant recommended improving the office ____ to reduce heating costs.
'Insulation' is material or treatment that reduces heat transfer.
The retailer opened a new distribution ____ near the airport.
A distribution 'facility' is a building or site used for storing and moving goods.
The human resources department updated the employee ____ to reflect the new leave rules.
An employee 'handbook' contains workplace policies and procedures.
Attendance at the safety ____ is mandatory for all new technicians.
A 'seminar' is a meeting or class for instruction or discussion.
The customer service representative opened a support ____ to document the technical problem.
A support 'ticket' is a recorded request for assistance.
The manufacturer recalled the product because of a possible safety ____.
A 'defect' is a fault or flaw in a product.
The applicant's technical ____ were verified before the final interview.
'Credentials' are qualifications or evidence showing that someone is suitable for a role.
The accounting department requested supporting ____ for every travel expense.
'Documentation' means records or documents that provide evidence or information.
The conference organizer confirmed the venue's seating ____ before opening registration.
Seating 'capacity' is the maximum number of people a venue can accommodate.
The supplier promised to replace the damaged goods at no additional ____.
A 'charge' is an amount of money required as payment.
The company expects the new software to improve staff ____.
'Productivity' is the amount or efficiency of work produced.
Please direct all media ____ to the corporate communications office.
An 'inquiry' is a request for information.
The store manager authorized an exchange because the item was still under ____.
Being 'under warranty' means the product is still covered by a repair or replacement guarantee.
The company plans to expand its online sales ____ into Southeast Asia.
'Operations' refers to a company's organized business activities.
The auditor found a small ____ between the recorded total and the bank statement.
A 'discrepancy' is a difference between things that should agree.
The manager approved additional overtime to clear the order ____.
A 'backlog' is accumulated work or orders waiting to be completed.
The sales representative sent the client a revised product ____ with updated specifications.
A 'brochure' is a printed or digital publication giving information about products or services.
The manufacturer is seeking a local ____ to handle repairs in northern Japan.
A 'distributor' is a business that supplies or sells products in a region.
The new employee will complete a three-month ____ period before the formal review.
A 'probation' period is an initial trial period of employment.
The finance director asked each department to justify any budget ____.
A budget 'increase' is an upward adjustment in allocated spending.
The courier requires the recipient's ____ upon delivery.
A 'signature' confirms receipt or authorization by the named person.
The hotel made a room ____ for the visiting consultants.
A 'reservation' is an arrangement to keep a room, seat, or service available.
